name: Quelli del Movimento Terra | Cerco Offro Lavoro
author: Quelli del Movimento Terra

sections.description:
1. Go to “Lavoro | QDMT” in the WordPress admin menu.
  2. Paste the token generated by the configurator on quellidelmovimentoterra.com.
  3. Save: the [qdmt_lavoro] shortcode, the “Cerco Offro Lavoro” Gutenberg block, and (if installed) the matching Elementor widget and WPBakery element are now ready to use. There is no per-instance configuration: they all use the same global token.

External services

This plugin uses the Quelli del Movimento Terra service to display job listings.

The plugin loads the following external JavaScript file every time the shortcode, block or widget is displayed:

https://quellidelmovimentoterra.com/api/embed.js

The plugin sends the configured API token to the service in order to retrieve the public job listings associated with the configured account.

No personal data from website visitors is intentionally collected or transmitted by the plugin.

https://quellidelmovimentoterra.com/termini-e-condizioni

Privacy Policy:
https://quellidelmovimentoterra.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin -> select the .zip file.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to “Lavoro | QDMT” in the menu and set the token.
sections.changelog:

  • Documentation improvements.
  • Added external services documentation.
  • First version: shortcode, Gutenberg block, Elementor and WPBakery integration.
